# NUVANX Medicina Estética Láser - AI Agent Accessibility

## Site Overview
NUVANX is a medical aesthetics clinic in Madrid, Spain, specializing in laser treatments and personalized medical aesthetic procedures with clinical criteria.

## Purpose
This file provides structured information for AI agents to understand the site's content, structure, and purpose.

## Core Information
- **Business Type**: Medical aesthetics clinic
- **Location**: Madrid, Spain (Chamberí and Goya clinics)
- **Specialty**: Laser medicine, facial treatments, body contouring
- **Philosophy**: Evidence-based medicine with individualized treatment plans

## Key Services
- Endolift facial treatments
- Laser medicine procedures
- Medical consultations and evaluations
- Personalized treatment planning
- Facial rejuvenation
- Body contouring

## Site Structure
- **Home**: Overview of philosophy and services
- **Treatments**: Detailed treatment information
- **Medical Team**: Professional profiles
- **Patient Cases**: Clinical evidence (when published)
- **Contact**: Clinic locations and contact methods
- **Blog**: Educational content

## Content Guidelines
- All medical content is evidence-based
- Treatment recommendations require medical evaluation
- No guarantees of outcomes are made
- Individual results may vary
- Professional medical oversight is emphasized

## Contact Information
- **Main Phone**: +34 669 319 836 (Chamberí)
- **Goya Phone**: +34 647 505 107
- **WhatsApp**: Available for quick inquiries
- **Locations**: Chamberí and Goya, Madrid

## Accessibility Notes
- Site follows WCAG AA standards
- Forms include proper labels and error handling
- Color contrast meets accessibility requirements
- Responsive design for all devices

## Content Authority
- Medical content is reviewed by qualified professionals
- Treatment protocols are clinically validated
- Professional medical licensing information is provided

## Technical Notes
- WordPress-based CMS
- Custom theme with medical aesthetics focus
- HubSpot forms for lead generation
- Google Analytics for performance tracking
- SEO-optimized for medical aesthetics terms

## Language
- Primary: Spanish (es)
- Secondary: English (en) for some content
- Medical terminology uses standard Spanish medical terms

## Legal & Compliance
- Compliant with Spanish medical advertising regulations
- Patient data protection follows GDPR
- Professional medical licensing displayed
- Clear pricing and treatment information
